name: erhaweb/klaro-consent-manager
description: Klaro! Consent Manager - Functionally complete, flexible TYPO3 integration of Klaro! Consent Management by KIProtect GmbH, a powerful tool that protects your visitors' privacy and data.

scripts.docs:watch: sh -c 'docker ps -q --filter "publish=5173" | while read id; do [ -n "$id" ] && docker rm -f "$id"; done; docker rm -f typo3-docs-watch 2>/dev/null || true; URL="http://localhost:5173/Documentation-GENERATED-temp/Index.html"; (sleep 2 && open "$URL") & docker run --rm -it --name typo3-docs-watch --pull always -v "$(pwd)/Documentation:/project/Documentation" -v "$(pwd)/Documentation-GENERATED-temp:/project/Documentation-GENERATED-temp" -p 5173:5173 ghcr.io/garvinhicking/typo3-documentation-browsersync:latest || test "$?" -eq 130'

scripts-descriptions.crowdin:import: Import existing local XLIFF translation files into Crowdin and approve imported translations.
scripts-descriptions.crowdin:export: Export approved Crowdin translations to local ignored XLIFF files.
scripts-descriptions.docs:watch: Watch the extension ReST documentation with Vite.
